version: v2 — noise → signal (own visual language, not the C-series)

music.note: riser peaks on the RGB-split cut (4.47), the track's break is the silence (volume 0 from 4.48 to 4.97), the drop lands with the pin (5.0)

registry: transitions-radial (Circle Iris recipe, ported into map.html)

beats.picture: a paper lock screen (19:04) is buried by 20 channel banners (neutral letter avatars, unread counters) landing faster and faster on the music, the frame shakes; the verdict slams in on paper strips through rgb-glitch-text; an RGB-split/band-tear filter ramps on the riser
hard cut: everything stops, the banners lose their words (grey slabs), then implode into one ink dot
the dot drops and becomes an ink pin with a bounce on the drop; the line types out under it; the camera dives into the pin's hole

map-kyiv opens full-bleed from the pin's hole as a circle iris (the gold stand-up pin sits in the hole), the camera drifts back over the clusters; annotation strips with leader lines; tap on the gold pin (436, 840) → crossfade map-kyiv-card → push onto the card

beats.picture: a field of ink/grey noise tiles resolves into the coral «Поряд»; the rest of the sentence types under it
